name: RC-B10-0394/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls on Cuba to release Félix Navarro, his daughter Saylí Navarro and all other political prisoners, and to stop torture and forced exile. It asks the European Union to use the human rights clause in its agreement with Cuba and to consider sanctions against those responsible for repression, starting with Miguel Díaz-Canel.

- No law changes; the Parliament demands the release of all political prisoners in Cuba.
- It affects Cuba's government and prisoners, including Félix and Saylí Navarro.
- Next, the EU should review its Cuba agreement and possible sanctions.
